safe_zone.source: Published only as downloadable template files (standard left-to-right, Arabic right-to-left, each with and without anchor); the size depends on ratio, caption length and extra formats. No fractions are published.

conflicts: The June 2026 in-feed help page allows up to 10 minutes; the TikTok Video Advertising Guide (https://ads.tiktok.com/business/en/guides/video-advertising-guide, read 2026-10-17) lists in-feed ads as up to 60 s with 21-34 s performing best; older spec pages listing 5-60 s are unsourced, historical. Use the current help page and re-check before delivery.
notes: Vertical 9:16 is recommended; 16:9 needs at least 960x540 and 1:1 at least 640x640.
File types mp4, mov, mpeg, 3gp, avi; at most 500 MB; bitrate at least 516 kbps.
Ad caption text is rendered by the platform in white with a fixed font; it is not part of the video.
No recommended resolution is published on this page; 1080x1920 is common practice, not an official value.
Use the right-to-left template for right-to-left markets.

safe_zone.source: Meta Ads Guide design recommendation: keep text, logos and key elements out of the top 14%, bottom 35% and 6% on each side.

notes: Minimum width is 250 px for ads under 30 s and 500 px for 30 s or longer; the stricter 500 px is recorded.
Captions are optional but recommended; sound is optional but strongly recommended.
Do not use licensed music; original or royalty-free audio only.
H.264, square pixels, fixed frame rate, progressive scan, stereo AAC at 128 kbps or more; at most 4 GB.
Primary text recommendation: 44 characters (platform UI text, not video text).

safe_zone.source: Meta Ads Guide design recommendation: leave roughly 14% top, 35% bottom and 6% each side free of text, logos and key elements.

notes: Videos under 16 s play in full; 16 s or longer may be split into up to three Stories cards. Meta states this as playback behavior, not a recommended length.
Aspect ratio tolerance is 1%.
Captions are optional but recommended; sound is optional but recommended.
Primary text recommendation: 125 characters (platform UI text, not video text).

safe_zone.source: Not verified: the feed spec pages required a login on 2026-10-17.

conflicts: 4:5 and 1:1 are widely cited for feed but were not confirmed on an official page on 2026-10-17.
notes: Confirm ratio, resolution, duration and safe zone in the Meta Ads Guide before delivering a feed cut.

safe_zone.source: No fractions published. The page describes a right-hand panel (like, dislike, comment, share) and a mobile CTA overlay card; keep key elements away from the right edge and the lower area.

conflicts: 1080x1920 is often quoted for Shorts but is not stated on the cited page on 2026-10-17.
notes: Only the first 60 s play in the Shorts feed; an overlay appears at 50 s.
Action-oriented ads: 10-30 s vertical. Video Reach: 6-60 s; other campaign types 10-60 s.
The CTA button appears at 3 s (Performance Max, App, Demand Gen) or 10 s (Video View, Video Reach).
Horizontal assets serve with blurred top and bottom bands.
The page asks advertisers to label AI-created or AI-edited assets where regulations require it.

conflicts: The format page does not state an aspect ratio; 16:9 is the conventional landscape player ratio. Confirm before delivery.
notes: No maximum length; under 3 minutes is recommended.
Viewers can skip after 5 s, so the brand and hook should land before 5 s.
